opportunities.title: Replace placeholder logo
opportunities.body:
The current logo is something I had Claude whip up. I would prefer to have it created by a human. The generated logo is "a metronome with a sapling for the arm". Thas was what it came up with based on the name Templing being a portmanteau of "tempo" and "sapling".

I'm open to riffs on that theme. Something that invokes music and growth. Perhaps flipping it so it's a sapling sprouting some sort of

opportunities.title: Docs: translate docs/plugins.md and docs/github-actions.md to English
opportunities.body:
The README is now English-first (Portuguese in `README.pt-BR.md`), but `docs/plugins.md` and `docs/github-actions.md` are still Portuguese only.

Suggested layout: English in the current files and the Portuguese versions as `docs/plugins.pt-BR.md` / `docs/github-actions.pt-BR.md`, with a language link at the top of each and the README links updated (English README → English docs, `README.pt-BR.md`

opportunities.title: Interface in English (i18n)
opportunities.body:
The app UI is Portuguese only. An English UI (and a way to add more languages) would open Zeno to many more users.

Ideas:
- a small dictionary per language in `src/renderer/src/i18n/` and a `t('key')` helper; language from the OS with an override in *Preferences*
- start with the most visible screens (sidebar, request/response panes, workspace screen, import) and migrate the rest gradually
- Go-s
